note.value: When a Sea Monster is not performing as its controlling Beast-Lord wishes, it speaks words of power and magical lightning strikes out from the Wild Mind allowing the Beast-Lord to control his charges more easily.

Restriction: Beast-Lord Only

The Wildmind may be used only once per turn. It allows the Dark Elf player to perform one of the following: Allow the Dark Elf player to re-roll the dice on the Doom-Diver table. Add one to a single Monster Reaction roll (i.e. a double 1 counts as a double 2). Prevent Triton using his 'Banish' ability on a roll of 4+ on a D6.
